name: Guest List
summary: An invite box that turns emails into chips, folds them into envelopes and flies them into your crew
about: A team invite card with a real chip field. Typed or pasted addresses become coloured chips, typos turn red and wobble, and Backspace removes the last chip in two presses. Press Send invites and each chip folds into a little envelope that arcs up into the avatar stack, where a new face pops in with a pending dot while the progress bar fills. It suits team tools, shared boards, event planners and any app with an invite step.
how: Type an email and press Enter, comma or space, or paste a whole list. Suggested people add with one tap.
A wrong address becomes a red chip that wobbles; press Backspace twice or its cross to remove it.
Pick Can edit or Can view on the sliding switch, then press Send invites or Enter in the empty field.
The button squashes, the chips lift, then each one folds into an envelope and arcs into the crew stack.
New faces pop in with sparks and a pending dot, the count updates, and the button shows how many were sent before it resets.
